register_gap: The onboarding gives every canvas one thought at 52-56pt serif (line pitch ~48-50pt, one italic punch word), one 13pt letterspaced caps eyebrow, and 300-430pt of composed emptiness floored by a single action; its only structure is a 0.5pt hairline. The app runs its display type a third smaller (~34-40pt; the evening letter's pitch is ~27pt), stacks three caps bands before the first serif word on Home, and replaces voids with 30-38pt seams between 8-11 stacked events per screen. The proof numerals invert: onboarding sets "500 calories" as a ~54pt didone monument, while the app's 860 sits at ~32pt inside a three-typeface sentence and 163.6 at ~20pt above its own chart. Add chrome the onboarding never shows — 7 chevrons plus a "tap to open" label on p2_becoming, 7 outline pills on p4_home_evening_list, a dismissible x prompt and a mid-sentence-truncated teaser on p5_functional_home — and the surfaces read as a well-organized dashboard wearing the magazine's typefaces.
onboarding_dna: Statement scale: headlines at ~52-56pt JeniHeroSerif with ~48-50pt line pitch and exactly one italic Fraunces punch word (beats 05, 10, 19); the app tops out around 40pt.
One caps event per canvas: a single 13pt eyebrow tracked ~+3pt (HER ARRIVAL, HER FOOD STORY); a second letterspaced line never appears.

Composed voids with a floor: 300-430pt of unbroken cream between the last line and the single CTA (beat 10), or content vertically centered in the field (beats 05, 19) — emptiness is framed, never leftover.

Number as monument or whisper, nothing between: '500' at ~54pt didone with an italic serif unit at its baseline and a plus-minus whisper (beat 13); every other numeral is a right-aligned ledger figure (~22pt).
Containerless structure: zero cards or borders on cream; 0.5pt hairlines at ~12% cocoa are the only dividers (beats 03, 08, 19); the only rounded objects are selection controls and the one CTA.
One action per canvas: a single ~64pt cocoa pill or a whispered 'tap to continue' — never both, never a secondary cluster.
Imagery runs full bleed edge-to-edge with a cream sheet rising over it (beat 13); a photograph is never boxed inside a card.
Ledger grammar for receipts: 17pt label left, serif value right with an italic punch (beat 19), rows at ~47-58pt pitch — a colophon, not a table.

screen_directions.direction: Collapse the three pre-headline bands into ONE 13pt eyebrow — MONDAY, JULY 27 · DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 — and delete the truncated FROM JENI teaser (a letter is never shown cropped mid-sentence; it lives one tap behind the dated eyebrow). The day's one thing rises to statement scale: 52pt, the first thing the thumb meets, ~96pt below the eyebrow. The calorie sentence becomes the page's single monument: 860 at ~72pt didone with 'of ~1,473 · room for ~600' as ONE 19pt italic-serif line beneath — one face, not three. Steps loses its icon and chevron and sets as a 17pt textSecondary line, '6,420 steps, counted for you.' The cycle connect card dies from this canvas. The kept-line list (the signature) is the page's only list, and the 185pt of leftover tail-void redistributes into 64-96pt stanza gaps that frame each thought. The screen becomes a dated page: one statement, one figure, a floor.

The landing stops being an index and becomes a COVER with a CONTENTS column. 'becoming' stays as the italic masthead; jeni's read grows to 52pt across up to four lines as the cover line; the six signal rows lose every chevron and the 'tap to open' instruction and reset as magazine contents — 13pt caps kicker over a 24pt serif line, 0.5pt hairlineCocoa rules, pitch loosened to ~104pt, the type itself the tap target. Inside the pager every spread adopts beat-13 grammar: one eyebrow, one 48-52pt statement, ONE didone figure (163.6 grows from ~20pt to ~56pt; on the protein spread the 58% evening share becomes a ~72pt hero instead of a twice-captioned bar row), one italic footnote. The duplicate caption rows and the restated closing line on folio_v6 die. The floating tab pill is suppressed inside spreads; the fore-edge carries position. It becomes an issue you thumb, not a list you scan.

The truest room already — protect it and finish it. The letter rises from ~34pt toward 40-44pt with pitch loosened to ~36pt so four lines breathe at beat-05 scale; 'JENI —— monday' stays the only chrome, 'jeni' with the heart stays right-set. The two stacked actions become one: the 72pt dark reply pill dies, 'reply' sets as a single 17pt italic line at the foot, and keeping happens on the page itself through the signature hold, the kept mark settling beside jeni's sign-off. Below the sign-off, nothing — the ~500pt of cream IS the letter's authority. One voice, one act, a page from her correspondence.

Strip the iMessage costume. Jeni's turns lose the pure-white bubbles and tails (white is off-palette on cream) and set as typeset paragraphs on bgPrimary marked by a 2pt accent rule or a small jeni glyph in the margin; her turns keep a soft accentSubtle field, 20pt radius, no tail. The pinned trend loses its white card-and-border and becomes a naked 1.5pt line drawing with an italic caption; the hairline-flanked italic 'today' divider is already right — keep it. The composer thins to a hairline rule with an italic placeholder and a small cocoa send disc, so a single layer of chrome sits above the tab bar. It becomes a printed dialogue: two voices told apart by ink and field, not by borrowed bubbles.

checklist_signature.concept_name: the kept line — jeni countersigns the day
checklist_signature.at_rest: No circles, no cards, no 'still open' sublabel. Each intention is a lowercase 26pt JeniHeroSerif line set in unset ink — cocoa at 40% — over a 0.5pt hairlineCocoa rule that runs only the width of the text, lines at ~72pt pitch. The day reads as a typeset table of intentions on the page, not tasks in a tray; the current radio-circle grammar on p4_home_evening_list ('snap a meal' beside a 44pt hairline ring) is deleted outright.
checklist_signature.completion: Press-and-hold, ~600ms — the hold-to-build gesture onboarding already taught. The line inks left-to-right to 100% cocoa like letterpress taking ink while its rule draws out to full column width; at ink-complete the jeni mark (the tab bar's sparkle glyph) lands at the line's end as terminal punctuation — 14pt, accent rose cooling to cocoa — and breathes once, 1.0 to 1.15 and back. Haptics run in three touches: a light contact on touch-down, a swelling medium at ink-complete, a feather tick as the mark settles. Nothing strikes through, nothing turns green; the sentence is simply finished, countersigned in jeni's own glyph.
checklist_signature.day_complete: When the last line keeps, the rules beneath every kept line glide together into one continuous hairline, the column exhales ~8pt of added letting-space, and a tailpiece prints centered beneath — 'monday, kept' with the mark — in 17pt italic Fraunces, as the existing landed-moment silk sweep crosses the page once under a long soft haptic swell. The day ends the way a chapter ends: with a colophon, not a cleared list.
checklist_signature.why_inevitable: It is print grammar inside a product that already speaks in letters, ledgers and folios — ink, rule, tailpiece. The sparkle is already jeni's signature in the tab bar, so a kept line literally reads as jeni countersigning her day, which is the product's whole promise; and the hold is the gesture her hand learned at the plan-build moment, so the app's first ceremony is one she already knows.

becoming_pagination.description: Pagination as the fore-edge of a closed issue seen from above: a centered run of one 0.5pt vertical tick per page, 8pt tall, 4pt apart. Pages already read are inked full cocoa; the current tick draws long to 14pt in accent rose; the pages ahead fade through 30% down to 12%. On each swipe the incoming chapter's name — 'sleep', 'weight' — surfaces beneath the ticks in 15pt italic Fraunces for about 900ms, then dissolves like a running foot. Position is felt as depth into the issue, the way a thumb senses how much of a magazine remains — never counted aloud, no numerals, no roman folio.

deletions: p5_functional_home: the truncated 'FROM JENI back after 10 days. this is day 12, n…' teaser row — correspondence never appears cropped mid-sentence.
p5_functional_home: the 'DAY 12 · WEEK 2 OF 20 · FINDING STEADY >' band as a second caps line, and its chevron — merged into the single dated eyebrow.
p5_functional_home: the cycle prompt row (left rule + copy + 'connect' outline pill + dismiss x) — the only ad-shaped, dismissible object in the house.
p5_functional_home and p2_becoming: the hamburger glyph — two top-right icons beside the camera disc is one too many; the menu folds behind one quiet mark.
p4_home_evening_list: all 7 outline pills (proud / okay / tender, plus the four tonight-plan pills) — the choices reset as inline serif words separated by interpuncts; the pill containers die.
p2_becoming: every chevron on the six signal rows and the 'tap to open' label — a magazine never points at its own pages.

folio_v6: the duplicated caption row (14% MORNING / 28% AFTERNOON / 58% EVENING repeating the labels already under the bars) and the closing line restating the FOR YOUR BODY note — one caption set, one thought per spread.
folio_scrollpager and folio_v6: the roman folio 'i · of xii' and the floating tab pill inside becoming's spreads — the reading room keeps its own edge and exit via the fore-edge.
one_transformative_move: Ban the middle register. App-wide, every element becomes either the page's ONE statement (48-56pt serif with an italic punch word) or a whisper (13pt caps, 17pt utility, ledger numerals) — with a single didone figure at 56-76pt allowed as the page's monument. The 20-40pt middle band where the whole dashboard currently lives (860 at ~32pt, becoming's signal lines at ~24-26pt, the letter at ~34pt, folio charts at ~20pt) dissolves upward into statements or downward into whispers. Enforce that one rule and every surface self-corrects to the onboarding's confidence — one voice, one figure, silence composed around both.
